protocol.day_timezone: Source calendar date; no kickoff times
protocol.audit_status: Previously viewed 2024/25 and 2025/26; descriptive comparison only
protocol.top_k_scope: All five markets, all ten leagues, multiple offers per fixture
protocol.odds_2_plus: Not evaluated: no historical timestamped odds

limitations: Already viewed seasons; no independent accuracy claim.
Fixture list is a retrospective snapshot, not an archived pre-kickoff schedule. Missing fixtures can change daily ranks.
Unknown outcomes remain in the ranking pool and are counted as unscored, never as losses or 0:0.
Day precision only; no reconstruction of odds or exact kickoff times.
Multiple offers from the same fixture are dependent. Wilson intervals are descriptive and assume independence; do not use them as proof.
Probability thresholds filter a fixed model; a higher selected hit rate is not a better model for all fixtures.
No live recommendations, odds 2+ test, ROI, lineups, weather or tactical inputs.
Newer candidate uses only result-derived features. Coach and player-pair inputs not available; no claimed contribution.
Model refits follow the previously chosen season/quarter policies, using only earlier available results.
